description: Seeded labeled training dataset for purchase/conversion prediction: per-customer features computed BEFORE the prediction window + will_purchase label (bought in the window). Leaky variant included for the leakage exercise.

seed.note: features/labels are deterministic functions of the Day 1 seed (42); seed is the random_state for the leakage-exercise split+model

fields.recency_days: int, dani od cut-off-a do poslednje kupovine (ili aktivnosti) PRE window-a; u leaky verziji od reference do poslednje kupovine (uklj. window)
fields.frequency: int, broj porudžbina pre cut-off-a (0 za ne-kupce); u leaky verziji ukupan broj porudžbina
fields.monetary: float, ukupna vrednost porudžbina pre cut-off-a; u leaky verziji uključuje window
fields.product_views: int, broj product_view događaja pre cut-off-a
fields.cart_adds: int, broj add_to_cart događaja pre cut-off-a
fields.sessions: int, broj jedinstvenih sesija pre cut-off-a
fields.aov: float, prosečna vrednost porudžbine pre cut-off-a; 0.0 za ne-kupce
fields.conversion: float 0..1, sesije sa kupovinom / sve sesije pre cut-off-a
fields.will_purchase: int 0/1, labela: 1 ako je korisnik kupio u prediction window-u (poslednjih window_days dana dataset-a)

reproducibility_note: No wall-clock timestamp is recorded here: the generator is byte-for-byte reproducible, so the sidecar must not change between runs. Regenerate with the same seed to reproduce all files.
